item.text: {"queries":["machine learning hypothesis elimination constraints from counterexamples behavioral class rejection nearest evidence search to search space refinement","state space input representation latent state history dependent deterministic system Markov sufficient statistics realization theory measurement tests"],"transfer_cards":[{"source_id":"LFF","structure":"Learning from failures uses a generate-test-constrain loop: test a candidate against examples, then translate its failure into constraints that prune generalizations or specializations. The excerpt describes theta-subsumption for logic programs.","assumptions":"The hypothesis language supports sound failure-derived constraints; the failed example and the constraint’s generalization or specialization direction are represented correctly. The excerpt’s pruning guarantee is for its ILP setting, not arbitrary response models.","target_mapping":"The certified collision excludes deterministic predictions whose complete input is only (u,h), conditional on exact matching, shared parameters, determinism, and the stated measurement bound. Treat that as a class-level constraint on candidate generation. A candidate may use the recorded pre-response history or an explicitly represented latent state; the collision alone does not select between them.","quantity_acquisition":"No new quantity is required to apply the exclusion. For a proposed predictor, refit every parameter on fit only and compute dev RMSE on raw o. The bundle does not provide an executable hypothesis grammar or fitted replacement.","transfer_test":"Reject any proposed deterministic (u,h)-only candidate under the certified premises. For each admissible candidate, verify that all its inputs are available before o; fit on fit only, then score raw o on separate dev. Test the exclusion on fresh matched trials by checking cross-history gaps against 0.030 and within-history repeatability."},{"source_id":"BMD","structure":"At each round, refit candidate families on accumulated observations, give the proposal process candidate forms and numerical feedback including residual diagnostics, validate and deduplicate proposals, and retain a bounded pool. The excerpt describes this as model expansion guided by predictive failures.","assumptions":"Candidate forms can be fitted on the available data, diagnostics are computed on the intended observations, and the proposal process does not use development targets when fitting. The excerpt does not establish that a resulting model is mechanistic or uniquely identified.","target_mapping":"Use the certified collision to motivate expansion beyond (u,h)-only predictors, then compare explicit history-dependent or state-based predictive candidates. The available fit and dev split permits prediction evaluation; the controlled dev collision is a constraint, not evidence for a unique mechanism.","quantity_acquisition":"For any specified candidate, compute its parameters by refitting on fit and compute dev predictions and raw-response RMSE. The bundle does not specify a candidate family or supply a complete replacement equation, so no replacement quantity can be calculated from it alone.","transfer_test":"Freeze the candidate specification before scoring dev. Refit all parameters on fit only, calculate dev RMSE against raw o, and report it alongside the old model’s supplied dev RMSE of 0.87517. Separately check whether predictions satisfy the certified history-collision constraint; predictive fit does not identify mechanism."}],"nearest_overlap":"The closest operations in the excerpts are LFF’s counterexample-driven hypothesis constraints and BMD’s expansion of candidate families using out-of-sample predictive failures and numerical residual feedback. The certificate supplies a mathematically verified class exclusion that can serve as a search constraint. These sources support the workflow pattern, not a claim that this particular constraint-transfer procedure is new.","unresolved_originality":"Search for prior work that converts behavioral equivalence-class or input-collision exclusions into constraints on scientific model-generation systems, and for prior work comparing recorded-history predictors with explicitly represented latent-state predictors under matched interventions. The excerpts do not establish novelty, a complete replacement model, or identification of a physical mechanism."}
